review_text: I received a free sample of The Inkey List Retinol Anti-Aging Serum from PinchMe and must say I was pleasantly surprised. I wasn’t sure what exactly to expect as a women in her 40’s from a retinol serum, but it actually helped improve fine lines. I highly recommend this product!

product_name: Premier Cru Dark Circle Correcting Eye Cream
review_text: I received a free sample of this Caudalie Premier Cru Dark Circle Correcting Eye Cream in exchange for my honest review. This eye cream is my new go-to eye cream. It does an amazing job brightening and de-puffing under eyes. It’s texture is so creamy and soft.I absolutely love the metal tip applicator - it works beautifully to use it to massage in the cream, and it instantly de-puffs. I would highly recommend this product. #freeproduct #trywithtopbox

I was hesitant as I have dark circles, crows feet, and bags under my eyes. should really say had. 2 weeks in and the crows feet are surely disappearing, the bags are also. I’m sure with more time and patience that the dark circles will too. I definitely recommend this. it is a little bit more than I intended to spend but I’m hooked and already purchased a second.
this eye cream has such a silky texture, feels so light on my skin!

product_name: Retinol Fast-Release Wrinkle Reducing Night Serum
review_text: I have been using this serum for several weeks now since I received it to try out.  The first thing that really threw me with this product is that you have to mix it prior to first use.  I know one issue for me was concern that I did not mix it up well enough.  I also felt that after mixing and removing the base there seemed to be a lot of product wasted.  I never had any irritation from this product maybe a slight redness on the first or second night, but overall no big issues.    I do think after I use this I will buy again.  I have definitely seen improvement on fine lines especially around my mouth.  As you can see in the pictures attached.  I have seen some slight improvements on my deeper lines around my eyes already but overall fine lines are looking better in just a few weeks!  I would recommend trying this.

product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
review_text: I really like this eye mask. It de-puffs my eyes and leaves them feeling moisturized. It’s reduced my eye wrinkles. I don’t have very dark circles under my eye so I can’t comment on that. I would recommend this product!

I really like the applicator and the cooling effect when applying but unfortunately don’t feel like I’ve seen much results for the price. I have only been using about a week or two and I forgot sometimes so that may be the problem and not the actual product. The eye roller applicator is the best though. Very soothing.

product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
review_text: This product is good , but not great- at least for my skin type. I personally feel like first aid beauty moisturizing cream was better. I use this now around eye area just  so I dont totally waste the product. I will not repurchase.

The Sunday Riley 5 Stars Retinol Eye Serum is everything i could hope for and more! It’s soaks in my under eyes quickly with no greasy feeling. This is amazing for my sensitive eyes and gentle enough to use every night. It’s super calming and a little goes a long way. It reduced the texture under my eyes as well. I couldn’t be happier with this eye serum.
This eye cream works pretty well. I like the coolness of the application - it feels very refreshing on my face.

product_name: UV Expert Aquagel Defense Sunscreen, Primer & Moisturizer SPF 50 Duo
review_text: Love this. It can easily be rubbed into the skin and leaves no white residue. In the summer I don’t even wear foundation when I have this on and in my early 40s that’s impressive. The only downfall is there is a slight smell to it but I haven’t really found a good sunscreen that doesn’t. I tried a few other brands this spring thinking I could find one for more value but all have been returned and I just repurchase this one.

product_name: Isle Glow Face Moisturizer SPF 45 with Sea Moss and Niacinamide
review_text: I wore this all summer. I liked the glow and loved the sun protection. Also, it wears well under foundation which is sometimes hard to find in a moisturizer.

I don’t really ever leave reviews, but I’ve been using this product for a solid 2 months now and I am OBSESSED. I love that this product is so lightweight. (I also use the Water Drench Cloud Cream Cleanser which is equally as light weight). This product makes me feel like I’m glowing and my skin is softer than ever. It’s been about two solid months of using this moisturizer and I will never look at anything else. LOVE it.

product_name: Acne+ 2% BHA and Azelaic Acid Acne Spot Treatment
review_text: So I have loved everything Skinfix for the last couple of years especially during the cold winter months with my skin needs moisture the most. Every product Skinfix makes is definitely top notch and deeply hydrating.

product_name: Soft Clean Infusion Hydrating Treatment Lotion
review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster to try. I enjoyed this product. A little definitely goes a long way so this product will last you awhile. I have dry skin and it felt really nice on my skin, for the price I would recommend this product!

product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
review_text: I can see a big difference in my skin! This product is very moisturizing and it brightens your skin. The reason that I gave it 4 stars is because I wish that it didn’t have scent in the ingredients.

This stuff is awesome! I’ve used other oils for my hair and this one sits at the top of the list. I just put a few drops in the palm of my hand, rub them together, and smooth through towel dry hair. It leaves a little left over residue on your palms so just use that for your knees or elbows and they are super soft! This makes your hair really shiny and gives it a yummy scent, I will definitely be purchasing this again. :)

product_name: Mini C.E.O. Vitamin C Brightening Rich Hydration Moisturizer
review_text: Cream is too thick and leaves residue on your hands after. Feels too thick on your skin rather than smooth and hydrating. Only pro is it smells great.

product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya
review_text: I just love the aesthetic design of this moisturizer for some reason. It’s a great summer cream, light but not too watery.

product_name: Emerald Hemp Seed Deep Moisture Glow Oil
review_text: I used this when I was experiencing really dry, tight, damaged skin and it was extremely soothing and helped lock in a lot of moisture. It’s lightweight enough to use in the morning under my makeup and absorbs quickly. Highly recommend giving it a try.

product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
review_text: literally cleared my skin so much when i paired it with the glow recipe watermelon toner and cetaphil gentle skin cleanser , def recommend but you have to really trust the process cuz it took like 3 months bc of me using too much for my skin but yeah please get it its so good and will prob work fast for u as long as you keep your skin routine short

These are my holy grail! I’ve tried soooo many acne products and countless spot treatments and pimple patches and these are my everything. I always make sure I stock up on these because I can’t go without them. I will forever recommend these to anyone and everyone.

Let me start off by being annoying and say that I have never had bad skin. Not even during puberty. In college I had the worst diet, stayed out late and STILL had beautiful skin. This past year all of a sudden, (of course when I am my most responsible with diet and exercise) I started getting red patches on my cheek, not white heads, but red bumps which wouldn’t go away. I was reading every skin care review possible. I looked at Allure every day for drug store/higher end brand reviews. I tried all natural remedies, argan oil, clarisonics, Murad (which I use to use) and was becomming very desparate. I received a sample of Soy Cleanser in the mail and tried it because I had nothing to lose. The texture and silkiness alone made me a convert. My skin as cliche as it sounds felt fresh for the first time and baby soft. I now wash my face with the Soy cleanser twice a day and moisterize with the ever amazing Lotus skin renewal. My face has been clear and gorgeous for over a month now and I am in heaven. I literally look forward to washing and using Fresh products; they feel like a dessert for your face!!!

This does work, but it’s very harsh and drying. It made my makeup look uneven the day after applying it because it dried my skin out so much where I applied it. The smell is also very strong. I had to return after one use, I didnt like the idea of applying something so strong like that to my face.

I use a chemical exfoliant 1-2x per week for my sensitive skin, and I’ve really enjoyed the Murad Daily Clarifying Peel over the past few weeks. It’s effective at keeping my pores clear, which is the main reason I use chemical exfoliants. Just be sure to shake it since it has a dual-phase formula.
i was so excited to try this out after getting it from the birthday bundle since i heard great things about it: made me break out a few days later and i barely have problems with acne

It was gifted by Benefit Cosmetics. I used this mask this morning. It’s in a Tiffany color which I like. Smells like typical mug/clay mask which I don’t mind. I applied an even layer after cleansing on dry skin. It took about 10min for the mask to be completely dried. I then rinsed with warm water. I felt my skin was brighter after the mask. I can’t say it does too much to my pores yet. So I will continue using it in hope to see more good result.

product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
review_text: I received this #complimentary along with The Essence for testing purposes. I remove all my makeup followed by The Essence to prep my face for the Violet-C Brightening Serum to help with my redness and uneven skin texture. Other Vitamin C serums are way to sticky/tacky and I don’t like feeling. This is light and absorbs instantly. I have definitely noticed a difference in the texture of my skin. I didn’t have pigmentation to start with, however I can see that my skin is smoother and more even. The Violet-C Brightening Serum is packed with a 10 percent concentration of exfoliating alpha hydroxy acids sourced from seven different fruits to promote radiance and boost the brightening effects of vitamin C. Definitely recommend! #ISeeVioletC #influenster #tatcha #skincare #selfcare #skinbrightening

Really nice results from this mask. My skin feels really soft and nourished (I have oily skin and it doesn’t clog pores). I apply a small quantity and warm it up between my fingers before applying to face. It’s very rich and full of good ingredients I don’t expect it to be smooth and easy to apply I just care for it to work.

product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
review_text: I used this over the course of the past 2 weeks, and I am not sure I will ever stop using it. The texture of the cream is great. You almost immediately feel a difference with the skin. It is firm and revitalized within days of using it. I do not have a huge wrinkle problem (yet), but it does feel like smoothened the lines that I already have.I think this is much better than a lot of other more expensive creams I tried, and I would recommend giving it a try.
Love this. apply smooth. Only one my toddler will put on his face without fighting. I will apply over makeup mid day to keep me protected.

This is such a pretty color! I love purple but there aren’t that many purple-toned skincare products from brands I like so this is a welcome surprise. As a visual person, this definitely adds to the experience for me. I like the formula too, it’s thick but absorbs pretty well so I don’t smear it all over my pillowcase. My skin always feels so soft and hydrated in the morning! gifted by Farmacy Beauty

I’m impressed. Received as a sample, tried it for the first time last night. It was very moisturizing, plumping and (knock on wood) didn’t cause my sensitive skin to feel irritated or break out. I think I’m going to purchase a full size pretty soon.

product_name: Power Couple Advanced Retinol and Lactic Acid Duo
review_text: This set is amazing after the first use I noticed a huge difference. I reorder two more sets during the sale. I wish the Good Genes was a larger size but I can’t be without these.

Gifted by Glow Recipe. Absolutely adore this lip balm. The scent is amazing and it makes my lips feel silky smooth and hydrated! I also appreciate the slight pink tint it gives my lips. Can’t wait to try the watermelon one.

product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
review_text: It does not melt is cakes. Does not absorb, sits like a top inconvenient layer interfering with the rest of your moisture routine. Have to ready run it around the eye area which leaves the skin feeling sore. Although their other products are great, this is a solid disappointment and waste of a lot of money. Disappointing!
Great Product! Works well even when the weather is dry! I recommend!

product_name: Acne Solutions Cleansing Bar For Face and Body
review_text: Love it! Been using this line of product, I have been using it for 3 years and I won’t change ever!

I just put 3 stars because I know the formula of what contains is excellent, but i dont really like the texture of the product. I was expecting a jelly water formula and it’s the complete opposite. But for the formula I recommend the product. It isn’t bad.
I feel like this gets every little bit off.  Love it.

product_name: Mini Faded Serum for Dark Spots & Discoloration
review_text: It honestly smells exactly like Nair hair removal r cream. The smell is so strong I have to hold my breath to put it on and the smells does linger afterwards. I haven’t seen any noticeable improvements yet, will not re purchase

product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
review_text: I love this rose toner it’s really fresh and smell like roses
Not for me. Don’t like the smell and it caused lots of white heads on my chin and forehead.
Really fine mist and it helps make my powder melt into my skin I like it

product_name: Full Spectrum 360° Sun Silk Drops Organic Sunscreen SPF 30
review_text: Absolutely loved this product! Works wonders, smells amazing, and is so worth it!! Will be getting this again!

product_name: Vitamin B Serum with 5% Niacinamide and Peptides
review_text: This is a good product for those looking for an easy going serum. The packaging is beautiful, however I was expecting a better scent. But that aside, this product felt great going onto a clean face

First, love love love that it is a more natural product.  The texture is really nice and goes on very smoooth (I have not had problems with pilling).  Also, it’s definitely very moisturizing.  Some other reviewers have mentioned not liking the smell, but I actually like the smell, if you can even call it a smell - its pretty much non-existent (who wants a bunch of fragrance, that’s not natural!) so maybe the reviews are from people used to heavy fragrance in their products?

Very nice! Haven’t noticed a huge change yet, but I’ve only had it two days, and the product is certainly working for my friend. Not at all thick and annoying, and the fragrance is light and “simple”. A little goes a long way btw. I feel so high-class using this. :)

I was so excited to get to try this for free. The packaging is beautiful! I love the idea of using pods for refills. Very luxurious moisturizer. I do not like the smell. All I can smell is turmeric..not a fan of it.  But it did leave my skin soft, and smooth. Will definitely continue to use.

product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
review_text: First time trying a Tatcha product and I wasn’t disappointed. It is very hydrating which I love because my skin goes through random phases where it becomes extremely dry around my eyes. The only thing I wasn’t crazy about was the fact that it had a fragrance. It wasn’t a horrible scent, but I don’t like putting fragrances on my face.

I love this product for a DEEP clean!  I add a small amount of water and really work the product into my skin and it feels like it gets EVERYTHING out, especially my left over makeup from my initial cleanse!  I can;t wai tto use this in the summer time to get all of my dead skin off or when I need a skin refresh.  Absolutely LOVE this!

Left my skin feeling cleanser and soft, not squeaky clean which creates micro tears and more flare ups. I love to use this for my combination skin, and even left my mom’s dry skin with rosacea much more calm with significantly less redness.

It is a good cleanser. I don’t understand how it is rated higher than the clarifying cleanser, but I certainly do see my pores looking better and the overall balance of my skin is getting better too, but I can’t give the praise to solely this product because I use a variety of skincare for my morning and night routine.I will say, I wish the product didn’t feel like it was just sweeping into the water—it just doesn’t seem like i’m really cleaning my face. So I would suggest using another cleanser if you really want to feel clean.

I love these!!! I use the green version but it will not showing up for the review. It is a pretty strong scrub on one side and a nice feeling cloth on the other. It cleanses superbly and doesn’t have a strong smell. I can’t find anything like this in any other brand.

This lip balm did not work for me at all. I always exfoliate my lips before applying lip balm or any lip products. When I applied this, it left a white cast on my lips and I had to go in and massage it on my lips thoroughly to get the white cast off. Next, it smells like plastic and I cant get the smell off. Even after wearing it for a while, the smell does not go away and it just bothers me. Once you look past the smell, sticky feel and the white cast, it is okay at hydrating and has minty feel on the lips. But I dont think you need to spend $20 for a lip balm with such cons. I tried this lip balm without any lip scrubs, I tried it with lip scrub (Lush), and I tried it with and without lip mask (Laneige). However, I still get the sticky feel, the smell.If you truly need a lip that does not feel sticky, has no smell, leaves no white cast, and is truly full of hydration and nourishment....try the Tatcha lip balm ($36). Yes, it is expensive, but everything about the Tatcha lip balm is worth it.I usually buy EOS or the Burt Bees lip balms because I like minty feeling on my lips. But once I discovered Tatcha lip balm, I have not gone back to the drugstore ones.

I love to use this product at night to start my cleansing process, it feels so wonderful to remove your makeup. I have even gotten used to the bitter taste as the other reviews have noted if you get it on your lips. The only flaw is the bottle design, it continually leaks, need to go back to the design drawing board for that, I bought a beautiful glass dispenser and that did the trick. I have combo skin that is very sensitive and highly reactive with acne at times, this cleanser is very calming, my skin looks forward to its nightly routine. Lush is the best word to describe it.

This cleanser did a great job of exfoliating and brightening my skin. I don’t know that I could see a difference right away but my skin felt very refreshed and clean and it didn’t dry it out which can happen with these exfoliating products. Loved it but a little pricey for me so I’m a maybe on buying it. It’s really nice though!

I absolutely love my rice wash cleanser from Tatcha!! It is the perfect facial cleanser!! It left my face feeling refreshed, hydrated and soft!! It is my new go to! It’s gentle and has amazing, clean ingredients!!!

This is a very nice cleanser. Prior to this I was using Proactiv and similar brands. This cleanser combines a toner in the formula and I found that all of the makeup residue is removed with the cleanser. I use a makeup remover prior to cleansing and use my clarisonic... there is a lot of product in the container for the price... will probably purchase again.

Fresh and natural. It is a very good daily cleanser, one of better ones out there. For those that are sensitive to “natural scents“ I don’t recommend it just because it does have a little hint of the soy scent to it.
